items.html: However, his Nukva has ten lights illuminating in her ten Sefirot. And this is the secret mentioned in Parashat Pinchas: that Lilith is called 'the growth upon the liver,' that she overcame her husband, and she rules over her male. And it is as we stated above, that she has an advantage over him: she has ten lights, and he has only his six lights. However, the reason that he spread out to ten Sefirot, although he has only six lights, is for the sake of Lilith, his Nukva, who also spread out her ten Sefirot, by his giving her her ten Sefirot, as is known that the Nukva has nothing except from the side of the male. However, with regard to the spirituality within her, she takes those nine Sefirot that departed from the Nukva of holiness of Atzilut.
